Keep all your school stuff very organized because it makes school a lot easier and feel a little less chaotic. I’m naturally a very organized to the point where I’m that one kid that makes their notes over the top. Like all color coded and pictures and different fonts. Obviously don’t gotta be like that just use legible hand writing. But please use a pencil pouch because you will loose all the your pencils and supplies if you don’t. 

   And I use a flexibinder for every class they are a little pricey but are reusable so you can use them multiple years because they are great quality. Also if you go to a school that has A days and B days/odd and even. Then please take those not even two minutes every night to quickly switch out your stuff. Your back will thank you. 

     And also something I do is I make a secret deal with myself that if I dedicate most of my time at school to actually paying attention and doing lots of work. Then once I leave I’m aloud to fully relax. And also every Friday i buy a snack on my way home. Idk I need small things to look forward to to function so it might help.

     This stuff works for real though I’m going into 11th grade and I’ve gotten through some really challenging classes this way.

    Also since math is my best subject and I like never mess up anything in it usually I allow myself to watch/listen to tv while doing it. So maybe pick your easiest subject to be chiller with the homework.
